newsitem.title: USA: Police probe suspected new Cunanan killing-TV.
newsitem.headline: Police probe suspected new Cunanan killing-TV.

text.p: FBI agents and police are investigating a killing in Miami they suspect was committed by Andrew Cunanan, sought in the murder of fashion designer Gianni Versace, a local television station reported on Thursday.

Police said a man had been found murdered in his home in the Miami Springs neighbourhood and a white man of similar height to Cunanan was seen running from the scene. They did not confirm the TV report that Cunanan was a suspect.
Metro-Dade police spokesman Pat Brickman said he could not confirm that the Miami Springs killing had any link to the Versace investigation but FBI agents were going to the scene.
"They're going to the scene because it is a homicide. They're going to anything that has any kind of similarity...or any point of reference (to the Versace investigation)," he said.
Miami Springs lies just north of Miami International Airport. The suspect in the killing was described as a white male with dark hair in his late 20s or early 30s, Brickman said.
Versace was shot and killed Tuesday at his Miami Beach mansion. Police say Cunanan, an alleged serial killer and one of the FBI's most-wanted fugitives, is their only suspect in the Versace murder.
